title: Seagate expands lineup as personal data continues to grow
summary: Explore Seagate’s latest consumer storage drives built to help you save, protect and access more photos, videos, projects and digital memories.
body_markdown:
As consumers create more digital content than ever before — from smartphone photos and 4K videos to creative projects and AI-generated content — the need for simple, reliable storage continues to rise. Today, Seagate announced three new additions to its consumer storage portfolio designed to help people save, protect and access the content that matters most: the Expansion desktop, Expansion portable and One Touch® portable.


The growth of personal data is being driven by several trends. Higher resolution photos and videos require significantly more storage than previous generations of media, while AI tools are enabling consumers to create and collect more content than ever before. At the same time, many people prefer to retain their digital memories and files rather than delete them, creating a growing need for affordable, high-capacity storage.


To address these evolving needs, Seagate's refreshed portfolio offers solutions tailored to different lifestyles and storage requirements.


The new[One Touch portable](https://www.seagate.com/products/personal-storage-devices/one-touch-portable-external-hard-drive/) combines portability with additional tools designed to help users stay organized and protected. Available with up to 4TB of capacity, the drive includes features such as search capabilities, data recovery support and automatic backup tools that simplify managing growing digital libraries. It's designed for users who want more than basic storage, offering an easier way to protect and find important files over time.


For consumers who need storage on the go, the[Expansion portable](https://www.seagate.com/products/personal-storage-devices/expansion-portable-external-hard-drive/) offers up to 4TB of capacity in a lightweight 2.5-inch form factor. Compact and easy to carry, it provides everyday storage for transferring files, backing up important content and expanding the storage available on a laptop or desktop computer.


The[Expansion desktop](https://www.seagate.com/products/personal-storage-devices/expansion-desktop-external-hard-drive/) is a 3.5-inch external hard drive that delivers up to 30TB of capacity, making it ideal for users looking to consolidate years of photos, videos, documents, creative projects and other personal files in one place. Designed for home offices and digital collections that continue to grow, it provides high-capacity storage with simple plug-and-play usability.


Together, these new products reflect a broader shift in how consumers interact with data. Personal archives are expanding, content creation is accelerating and digital memories have become increasingly valuable. Whether users need a high-capacity solution for a growing home collection, portable storage for everyday use, or enhanced tools for backup and recovery, Seagate's latest consumer drives are built to provide more room for what matters most.


Learn more about the newest members of Seagate's lineup:[One Touch portable](https://www.seagate.com/products/personal-storage-devices/one-touch-portable-external-hard-drive/) ,[Expansion portable](https://www.seagate.com/products/personal-storage-devices/expansion-portable-external-hard-drive/) and the[Expansion desktop](https://www.seagate.com/products/personal-storage-devices/expansion-desktop-external-hard-drive/) .
